title: When “Ekekekek” Turns Into a Yawn 😹🐦
description:
Cupko spots a bird flying across the sky and immediately starts making those classic “ekekekek” sounds. 😹🐦

As he follows the bird higher and higher with his eyes, his excited chatter slowly turns into… a yawn. 😂💤

And just when you think the moment is over, Cupko leaves the frame with one last little sound. 🐾❤️

Sometimes watching birds is exhausting work. 😹
